Measured warm-cache pass: 34265 ms p50 vs 54333 ms cold; HTTP cache hit rate 0.841 vs 0.311; LLM cache hit rate 0.733 (the rest missed because a flaky upstream call changed the evidence, hence the prompt).
v1 sends 4.9x the synthesis input tokens of v0 (every evidence item, with IDs) and adds one verifier call per claim: reliability is bought with tokens, not free. Caching is what claws it back.
Prompt caching does not apply: the prompts are far below the minimum cacheable prefix. Response caching is the lever.
